findings.passage: “I am proud to cosponsor and vote for legislation that, if approved by the voters, would enshrine voter ID requirements in Wisconsin’s Constitution. Since the voter ID law went into effect in 2012, voter turnout has risen in Wisconsin. We saw record-breaking turnout percentage in the 2020 presidential election and a record-breaking number of votes were cast in the 2024 election.”
findings.note: Statement in his name after the Senate passed SJR 2 (photo ID constitutional amendment) 17-15 on 2025-01-08. He says he cosponsored it. Listed on his Senate site as 'Marklein Celebrates the Passage of Voter ID Constitutional Amendment'.

findings.passage: “This common-sense reform is supported by a vast majority of Wisconsinites and enshrining it in our State Constitution will ensure that it is around for years to come. I look forward to the State Assembly passing SJR 2 and sending this question to the voters.”
findings.note: Same release; he cites public support for the amendment.
